words.hook: 谐音“一帮人离开”→ 抛弃、放弃
words.ex: The sailors had to abandon the sinking ship.
words.ext: 水手们不得不弃船逃生。
words.sample: They had to ______ the old car before it broke down. (abandon)

words.hook: 词根 ac+quire“追求”→ 获得知识/技能
words.ex: She acquired fluent English through years of practice.
words.ext: 她通过多年练习掌握了流利的英语。
words.sample: It takes time to ______ a new skill. (acquire)

words.ex: The report offers a comprehensive analysis of the market.
words.ext: 这份报告对市场进行了全面分析。
words.sample: We need a ______ review of the whole system. (comprehensive)

words.trans: adj. 关键的；至关重要的
words.hook: cruc 十字路口 → 关键抉择点
words.ex: Sleep is crucial for memory consolidation.
words.ext: 睡眠对记忆巩固至关重要。
words.sample: This step is ______ to the success of the plan. (crucial)

words.hook: de+rive 河流 → 从源头流下来 → 源于
words.ex: Many English words derive from Latin.
words.ext: 许多英语单词源自拉丁语。

words.hook: e+limin 门槛 → 把…赶出门槛 → 消除
words.ex: We should eliminate all unnecessary expenses.
words.ext: 我们应该消除所有不必要的开支。
words.sample: The goal is to ______ errors from the final draft. (eliminate)

words.hook: in+evit 逃避不了 → 不可避免
words.ext: 生活中变化是不可避免的。
words.sample: Some mistakes are ______ when learning a language. (inevitable)

words.hook: per+spect 看穿 → 全面透视 → 视角观点
words.ex: From a historical perspective, the decision was wise.
words.ext: 从历史角度看，这个决定是明智的。
words.sample: Try to see the problem from a different ______. (perspective)

words.hook: sign 标记 → 有标志意义 → 重要的
words.ex: There has been a significant increase in sales.
words.sample: This discovery is ______ to the whole field. (significant)

words.hook: sub+stant 站在底下撑住 → 有实质、扎实
words.ex: He made a substantial contribution to the project.
words.ext: 他对该项目做出了实质性贡献。
words.sample: The plan requires a ______ amount of time. (substantial)
